mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte derangements that impair pramipexole renal clearance, increasing risk of dopamine agonist toxicity including hallucinations, confusion, and orthostatic hypotension.
action: Monitor renal function closely; reduce pramipexole dose proportionally to creatinine clearance; assess for CNS and cardiovascular adverse effects; use amphotericin B lipid formulations when possible to minimize nephrotoxicity.
